prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1005; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather keep my name off this one, if that's okay. Just call me the driver of the gray sedan.

Q: That works for the file. Can you tell me where the collision happened?

A: It was on a main road in Sugar Land, Texas, near a shopping center. I was stopped at a red light, waiting to turn.

Q: What happened next?

A: I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and then back against the headrest. The other car had been following pretty close, and it didn't look like they had slowed down in time.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Only a second before. I glanced in the mirror and saw headlights getting bigger, and then it hit.

Q: Were you able to get out of your car?

A: Yes, but I was shaky and dizzy. A bystander asked if I was okay, and I told them I thought so, but my head was pounding.

Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?

A: I went to urgent care that same evening. They said I had a concussion and told me to rest, avoid screens for a while, and come back if I got worse.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: Still having headaches, and bright lights bother me. I've been sleeping more than usual and I get tired quickly.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Just that I want my vehicle damage and medical bills taken care of properly. I'm still recovering, so I'd appreciate it if you could keep me updated.

Q: Understood. This concludes the statement. Thank you.
